programmes.detail: As named in the scholarship announcement. UNIC's doctoral list names the matching programme International Relations and European Studies, PhD, 3 years, School of Law, taught in English.

notes: Bachelor's: 41 programmes recorded. The UNIC Nicosia bachelor's list shows 47 entries in all; excluded because the announcement excludes them or they are not on-campus English-taught: 2 Medical School MD programmes (Undergraduate Entry MD, Graduate Entry MD), 2 distance-learning programmes (Business Administration BBA, Psychology BSc), and 2 taught in Greek only (Pre-Primary Education BEd, Primary Education BEd). The announcement does not list eligible bachelor's programmes itself, so this list is the UNIC catalogue filtered by the announcement's rule.

Teaching language was read on each programme page: 'English' or 'English and Greek' (Music, Psychology, Social Work, Law, Human Biology, Nursing, Nutrition and Dietetics, Pharmacy, Physiotherapy, Sports Science). Programmes taught in English and Greek are included because an English-taught version exists; editors may want to confirm with UNIC that the scholarship applies to the English track.

The Doctor of Veterinary Medicine is run by the School of Veterinary Medicine, not the Medical School, and is taught in English, so it is included; the announcement excludes only 'programmes offered by the Medical School'. Confirm with UNIC.

Several bachelor's pages state that no enrolments are available for the current semester (Tourism, Leisure and Events Management; Marketing and Digital Media; Sports Management; Dance; Music; Fine Art; Social Work; International Relations and European Studies). This is noted in each row; the scholarship is for the Spring 2027 intake so check intake availability.

Architecture is a combined listing: MArch (Integrated Master, 5 years, 300 ECTS) / BAArch (4 years, 240 ECTS). Pharmacy is a 5-year integrated master (MPharm) listed by UNIC among its bachelor-level programmes.

Master's: the 3 programmes named in the announcement are recorded (the full UNIC master's list has 35 on-campus programmes, which are not covered). UNIC also lists MBA specialisations (Energy, Oil and Natural Gas; Entrepreneurship and Digital Transformation; Finance; Human Resource Management; Marketing); the announcement names only 'MBA, Master in Business Administration', so these are not recorded as covered.
Doctoral: 1 programme recorded. The announcement says PhD in International Relations; UNIC's doctoral list and Fall 2026 call name it International Relations and European Studies.
The scholarship announcement is dated 12 June 2026 (Spring 2027 intake).
not_stated: The announcement does not give a list of eligible bachelor's programmes.
The announcement does not say whether MBA specialisations are covered.
The announcement does not say whether programmes taught in English and Greek are covered only in their English track.
